runs.sql: WITH first AS (SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) DESC LIMIT 1000) SELECT id FROM first ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) + 0.001 * price DESC LIMIT 20

WITH h AS (SELECT e.item AS item, i.cat AS cat, i.emb AS emb, e.action AS action, e.ts AS ts FROM events e JOIN items i ON e.item = i.id WHERE e.usr = :u ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 50), first AS (SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) DESC LIMIT 1000) SELECT id FROM first ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) + 0.001 * price DESC LIMIT 20

WITH h AS (SELECT e.item AS item, i.cat AS cat, i.emb AS emb, e.action AS action, e.ts AS ts FROM events e JOIN items i ON e.item = i.id WHERE e.usr = :u ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 50), first AS (SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) DESC LIMIT 1000) SELECT id FROM first ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) + 0.5 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h WHERE h.cat = first.cat) DESC LIMIT 20

WITH h AS (SELECT e.item AS item, i.cat AS cat, i.emb AS emb, e.action AS action, e.ts AS ts FROM events e JOIN items i ON e.item = i.id WHERE e.usr = :u ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 50), first AS (SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) DESC LIMIT 1000) SELECT id FROM first ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) + 0.5 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h WHERE h.cat = first.cat) - 0.0001 * coalesce((SELECT MIN(:now - h.ts) FROM h WHERE h.cat = first.cat), 100000) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h WHERE h.cat = first.cat AND h.action = 'buy') DESC LIMIT 20

WITH first AS (SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) DESC LIMIT 1000) SELECT id FROM first ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) + 0.1 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e WHERE e.usr = :u AND e.cat = first.cat) DESC LIMIT 20

WITH first AS (SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) DESC LIMIT 1000) SELECT id FROM first ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) + coalesce((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e WHERE e.usr = :u AND e.item = first.id), 0) DESC LIMIT 20

WITH h AS (SELECT e.item AS item, i.cat AS cat, i.emb AS emb, e.action AS action, e.ts AS ts FROM events e JOIN items i ON e.item = i.id WHERE e.usr = :u ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 50), first AS (SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) DESC LIMIT 1000) SELECT id FROM first ORDER BY bm25(title, :q) + coalesce((SELECT MAX(dot(h.emb, first.emb)) FROM h WHERE h.action = 'buy'), 0) DESC LIMIT 20
